room_description: A dark, green-lit industrial room resembling a control center or bunker, featuring metal panels, electrical boxes, large pipes, and a central metal door.

key_moments.description: Establishing shot of the industrial control room.
Collecting a blue and yellow keycard from the metal shelf.
Solving the 'Simon Says' style light pattern puzzle on the control panel.
Collecting a heavy metal pipe fitting from the opened panel.
Observing the number sequence on the pipe gauge.
Entering the color code sequence into the electrical box.
Solving the circuit connection puzzle on the large metal door.

solution_steps: Interact with the control panel showing a 2x2 grid of colored squares.
Repeat the sequence of flashing lights exactly as shown.
Find the keycard on the shelf and examine its color quadrants (Red, Blue, Yellow, Green).
Match the position of the colors to the input panel on the electrical box to unlock it.
Observe the pressure gauge to note the sequence of numbers it points to: 6, 2, 8, 3.
Enter '6283' into the keypad next to the electrical box.
Place the missing pipe fitting onto the door's circuit panel.
Rotate the tiles to form a continuous line connecting the two active nodes, creating a closed loop.

final_action: Upon completing the circuit puzzle, the heavy metal door slides open, allowing the player to escape.
